title: HB 2773 (89R): Relating to the unlawful altering of election procedures; providing a civil penalty.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id) not stated.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(other) Sec 1: rewrites Election Code 276.019: bars public and election officials from altering election standards or procedures not expressly authorized; secretary of state investigation and demand to comply; civil penalties up to $1,000 per day (days 3-7) and $5,000 per day (after day 7); attorney general may sue; penalties go to general revenue; investigation records confidential.
(other) Sec 2: effective date September 1, 2025.
(note) Off this topic: the bill sets no ID or citizenship-proof rule.
